# Verify Definition References

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `stdlib.analysis.verify-references` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/stdlib.analysis.yaml` |
| Tags | analysis, validation |

Pre-runtime safety net: fails the workflow if any `extends`, `mixins`,
`invoke`, `render`, `component(...)`, or `modules:` entry points at an id
or filename that does not resolve. Run before any definition execution to
surface graph breakage early.
